backup.production_rule: s106 (Lloyd: brands and sizes are OPTIONS under one stock item). New table public.inventory_item_options (RLS on, no grants to any client role, not in realtime), two security definer RPCs for authenticated (inventory_item_options_v1: read_operations, price key only when read_finance passes; inventory_item_option_set_usual_v1: manage_inventory, flips the usual option and upserts the item/supplier link as preferred), one internal seed function with no grants. The migration seeds supplier Shopsuki (online, notes 'Prices read from shopsuki.ph on 2026-10-31'), 60 options for 18 items of property 6ae230f4-c189-4547-84b1-cb6e0b2cc9bd, and one preferred inventory_item_suppliers link per item that has no preferred link (live read 2026-10-31: none had any supplier link, so 18 links). No existing table, column, policy or function is changed.
backup.notes: Phase expand: additive. The seed writes one inventory_suppliers row and 18 inventory_item_suppliers rows; the rollback script removes them again (only if nothing else uses the supplier).

forward_verification.name: options_table_no_grants
